outcome.technical: Attempt 2, on top of attempt 1's uncommitted invariant (scrub-by-default _manifest_io.atomic_write_json, raw_atomic_write_json by name, _output.raw_json_writer_violations + RAW_JSON_WRITERS). Followers fixed: (1) tools/prove-gates.py gains a red row (cripple raw_json_writer_violations to `return []`, case rj1) and an ALLOW row (ignore the allow-list: `if (named, where) not in allowed:` -> `if True:`, case rj2). Both proven by RUNNING them, in a throwaway copy of the working tree committed in a scratch repo (redfirst.sh refuses a dirty file in the shared tree): `python3 tools/prove-gates.py --only raw_json_writer` -> red: RED rj1, rj3, rj4 (1 of 1 proven red); allow: RED rj2, rj5 (1 of 1 proven quiet). prove-gates --selftest 37/37. (2) tools/gate-parity.py: RAW_JSON_WRITERS added to AUDITED_EXEMPTIONS as ("live", "raw_json_writer_violations") - the lint reports an unlisted reach and a row whose site no longer reaches the writer, but does not judge the reason, so `live` not `reason`; gate-parity --selftest 114/114 (p0, ea1, ea4-ea7 green). (3) test_run_test_gate.py rv5: cause found, it is NOT a quoted-path rewrite nor the returned pointers. rv5 built its spaced plan by COPYING `mp` after rv2 had run the printed retarget remedy; that remedy writes through audit-task -> _panel_write -> the now-scrubbing writer, which rewrote the buildCommands' in-checkout absolute paths (`<root>/say.py`, `<root>/dup.txt`) repo-relative to `root`'s checkout (probe: atomic_write_json of a command `<py> <root>/say.py <root>/dup.txt 0` reads back `<py> say.py dup.txt 0`). Copied into the `with space` checkout, those relative steps name files that do not exist there, both steps fail, no SAME SUITE line, no remedy. The product behaviour is the established plan-scrub (save_sharded/save_single_file already did it since P122.9; gate steps run with cwd=project, so repo-relative is equivalent there). Fix: the fixture writes the spaced plan fresh via `_plan(gate, at=spaced)` instead of copying a document the product rewrote; rv5 mutation (unquoted path) still distinguishes. test_run_test_gate --selftest 492/492. Gates run once on the final tree: `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py` exit 0, 318/318 files ok, 14857 cases; `python3 tools/check-committed-pii.py` exit 0; `ruff check plugins/audit tools` exit 0 (All checks passed!); test_audit_task --selftest 925/925. Findings for the orchestrator (not fixed, out of scope): the plan scrub also rewrites meta.buildCommands, so (a) a gate command naming an interpreter under a home directory (pyenv, ~/.local) is turned into the outside token and stops being runnable, and (b) when --project-dir is a SUBDIRECTORY of the git checkout, in-repo paths become relative to the checkout root while steps run with cwd=project - both pre-date this attempt (P122.9's save_sharded scrub) but the writer change widens their reach to every CLI verb.
